QUOTE: `retryFailedPost` in `post.ts:228` runs when the user taps the failed post (its caller is `app/components/post_list/post/body/failed/index.tsx`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says there are zero automatic retries, and that `retryFailedPost` runs only when the user taps the failed post. This matches "Try Again" in substance, though the button label itself isn't named.
